assets.design_brief: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: wide website hero banner for CipherEnc, a fully offline native desktop file-encryption app. Create a polished editorial 3D illustration of a precision-machined brushed-silver vault shield with a clearly recognizable closed padlock, protecting a small stack of blue file/folder shapes. Palette: CipherEnc navy #0a1d3a, cobalt blue #1769e8, silver #d8e2ee, cool white. Landscape composition about 2.5:1; subject in the right half, generous calm dark navy negative space in the left half for real HTML title and description. Restrained blue edge lighting and clean fine-metal texture, trustworthy and practical rather than hacker/cyberpunk imagery. No text, no lettering, no watermarks, no fake app screenshot, no people, no green or purple. Crisp silhouette and enough margin for responsive cropping.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: three-panel horizontal comic strip for CipherEnc's educational encryption website. Create exactly three equal-width bordered panels from left to right, consistent warm editorial comic art with clean expressive linework and blue #1769e8, navy #0a1d3a, brushed silver #d8e2ee, white palette. Same friendly adult educator in blue cardigan, fully clothed, at a desktop computer in each panel. Panel 1: educator selects a few ordinary document and folder icons on the computer, hands visible, calm expression. Panel 2: educator chooses a long password represented by a row of non-letter dots, a strong silver lock encloses the blue document icons and forms a single protected file; a small physical key remains with the educator, no cloud or internet imagery. Panel 3: the educator uses that key/password to open the protected file and checks that the restored documents match originals side-by-side, reassuring check mark. Communicate local processing on a single computer. No speech bubbles, absolutely no letters, words, numbers, fake interface text or watermarks; the website will supply accurate accessible captions below the panels. Maintain clear narrative continuity and simple composition legible at web size. Landscape 3:1 strip, all panels fully visible with generous margins.
